# Historical v0.1 writer compatibility fixtures

These fixtures preserve output from the pre-Milestone-A tokito-cli executable with SHA-256:
3f7725d36d65711309e234256072e142706c3f8d5542398c27d79ff00988bb4c.
They are historical writer outputs, not snapshots regenerated by the current Rust engine.

The four named board entries were copied from ignored baseline package outputs. Their manifest.json, derived/inspection.json, derived/placements.csv, and historical derived/svg-top.svg and derived/svg-bottom.svg are preserved byte for byte. Duplicate upstream PCB sources are omitted. The compatibility gate reconstructs each package using the unchanged corresponding source in tests/fixtures/open-source/ and checks its original manifest digest and byte length before invoking the actual CLI. Source provenance, pinned commits, and licensing are documented in docs/PCB_FIXTURE_CORPUS.md.

The synthetic-bow-tie package was generated separately with the same old executable. Its source is included because it is a synthetic test, not an upstream design. The crossing outline exercised the old inventory-package writer; historical package verification does not imply that the current physical SVG exporter accepts the invalid outline. It supplies no manufacturable-board or AR/device evidence.

Run the subprocess gate locally with a verified current binary:
python tests/compat_v0.py --binary target/local-verification/release/tokito-cli.exe

The gate checks historical package verification, exact inspection/CSV/top-SVG/bottom-SVG bytes for all four real-source packages, SVG rejection for the bow-tie, and checksum rejection after tampering with a temporary package. Output stays under target/compat-v0; archived fixtures are never rewritten. Complete file-set SHA-256 snapshots are pinned in the test so changing an artifact and its manifest together cannot silently replace the historical baseline.

| Entry | Archived file-set SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| sparkfun-default-kicad | f6bfa8dd2a1f24cadca002b617584cd80ba109f6b58f3bf1d630e8ff328aab7d |
| raspberry-pi-pico-community | fdab7cbf96a1c8b8d52a10acae7f16f6c85310be3a2bc25b00ab037b6e36efa8 |
| arduino-uno-r3-community | 6197f0a8bf039c600e5386da7cf5abe6bad5550e5b4b4a2c1c21bc8f198a84bc |
| nxp-mcxa-esc | a10b81f7e8eed26ba9d44556a7efb10ea16e86192a34709bdd2511dccb8f4033 |
| synthetic-bow-tie | 9b7b60702ecc91404da97a285cb940cd2c14e23cacda746c09b70b7f7faeee04 |

Snapshots concatenate the fixed-order archived relative filename, a NUL byte, decimal byte length, another NUL byte, and exact file bytes for each member. The four real-board snapshots omit source/board.kicad_pcb; the synthetic snapshot includes it.
